svg.aria-label: HTTP/1.1 sends one request at a time per connection so browsers open several connections; HTTP/2 multiplexes many streams over one TCP connection; HTTP/3 runs streams over QUIC on UDP so a lost packet only delays its own stream.
svg.title: HTTP/1.1 sends one request at a time per connection so browsers open several connections; HTTP/2 multiplexes many streams over one TCP connection; HTTP/3 runs streams over QUIC on UDP so a lost packet only delays its own stream.
svg.text: HTTP/1.1 · text · one request at a time per connection
HTTP/2 · binary · many streams on one TCP connection
HTTP/3 · QUIC over UDP · streams independent
request waits for the one before it
header compression · but one lost packet stalls all
QUIC: TLS built in, faster setup
lost packet delays only its stream · survives Wi-Fi → 4G
